import hashlib, json, pathlib, re, subprocess, urllib.request
inputs = json.loads(pathlib.Path("docs/kickoff/1401/evidence/review-inputs.json").read_text())["inputs"]
raws = {}
for item in inputs:
    repo, revision, path = item["repository"], item["revision"], item["path"]
    assert repo in {"https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills", "https://github.com/wildcat-finance/v2-protocol"}
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", revision)
    assert not pathlib.PurePosixPath(path).is_absolute() and ".." not in pathlib.PurePosixPath(path).parts
    if repo.endswith("/skills"):
        data = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", revision + ":" + path])
    else:
        url = repo.replace("https://github.com/", "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/") + "/" + revision + "/" + path
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as response:
            data = response.read(1048577)
    assert len(data) == item["bytes"], path
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == item["sha256"], path
    raws[(revision, path)] = data
original = raws[("2dbfe40e08ee41429c521e0089a31ed872a1890d", "docs/kickoff/1401/exitpolicy.md")].decode()
revised = pathlib.Path("docs/kickoff/1401/exitpolicy.md").read_text()
assert original[original.index("1. A holder"):original.index("\nProducer:")] == revised[revised.index("1. A holder"):revised.index("\nProducer:")]
a = raws[("a70f297fbd1b1ab597e0e9a3458a2d13a34b4657", "src/access/FixedTermHooks.sol")]
b = raws[("5838b2f3f5c0bb3489cd2ff16bb31ddd5194c7fa", "src/access/FixedTermHooks.sol")]
assert a.replace(b"MaximumLoanTerm = 365 days", b"MaximumLoanTerm = 730 days", 1) == b
assert raws[("e1f77540fef65736374de6c847743d8ca2233fb4", "src/OpenAccessRoleProvider.sol")] == raws[("5838b2f3f5c0bb3489cd2ff16bb31ddd5194c7fa", "src/OpenAccessRoleProvider.sol")]
for item in inputs:
    if item["kind"] == "suite-reference":
        assert subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "bdcf124b933a37a820d89e29e1d7b81413488150:" + item["path"]]) == raws[(item["revision"], item["path"])]
print(json.dumps({"bindings_verified": len(inputs), "original_host_sources_verified": 13, "additional_host_sources_verified": 6, "suite_references_verified": 14, "original_records_verified": 2, "merged_correction_records_verified": 2, "maintainer_answers_unchanged": True, "fixed_term_only_difference": "MaximumLoanTerm: 365 to 730 days"}, sort_keys=True))

import json
cases = [(1, 1, 3, 0, 0), (9, 1, 3, 3, 0), (9, 1, 3, 1, 2)]
for paid, share, total, collected, expected in cases:
    assert paid * share // total - collected == expected
print(json.dumps({"formula_examples": len(cases), "results": [0, 0, 2], "evm_execution": False}, sort_keys=True))
